assertion.statement: The actual f_n recurrences and cleared scalar equations match the short model and are reversible on the guarded nonzero torsion-free branch.
assertion.objects: E:y^2=x^3+Ax with actual A=-d^2; f_n,psi_n,phi_n,omega_n and actual scalar-template input P.
assertion.hypotheses: E nonsingular; P belongs to the established torsion-free carrier; n!=0 on the affine scalar branch; inverse-norm equations correctly encode nonvanishing in K0.
assertion.quantifiers: Each integer n and each carrier input, using explicit n=0 and identity branches separately.
assertion.parameter_range: All integer scalars; nonidentity P in the guarded branch.
assertion.uniformity: Only the stated fixed objects and parameter range are covered; no additional uniform bound is asserted.
assertion.normalizations: psi_n=f_n for odd n and2y f_n for even n; corrected numerator minus sign; exact displayed f0..f4.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Identity and scalar0 use identity output; negative n uses negation; never cancel a specialized zero ordinate.
assertion.limit_order: Derive polynomial recurrence identities, establish psi_n(P)!=0 on this branch, then clear denominators reversibly.
